publicationArtifacts.cliArtifactIdentity: All runs report version 0.5.7; a common binary SHA-256 and source revision were not captured consistently.
publicationArtifacts.scope: Aggregate results, bilingual grouped bar chart, methodology and per-harness limitations. Raw prompts, answers, traces and ledgers are not included in this public summary package.

comparisonPolicy.selection: One measured reference candidate per harness; candidate versions are independent and are not a shared release axis.
comparisonPolicy.primaryInterpretation: Compare stock and FiLens within the same harness. Cross-harness results are descriptive, not a strict ranking.
comparisonPolicy.modelPolicy: Keep the model fixed within each harness pair. A single model was not available across every harness.
